policy.keep: The original collected case names and behavioral assertions remain authoritative in the original file.
policy.adapt: Requires a non-empty reason and one or more existing V9 replacement test paths before the original may change.
policy.retire: Allowed only for an explicitly retired protocol and requires a non-empty reason plus one or more existing V9 replacement test paths.
policy.currentBaselineDecision: All protected definitions are keep; no assertion is weakened or replaced in G03.
